selection.name: Nature's Attendants
selection.description: A cloud of wisps heals the caster and any friendly units nearby. Lasts 12 seconds.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Increases heal by 20 and wisp count by 5. Adds 3 permanent wisps.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Summons another swarm of evil attendants that damages enemies.

selection.name: Nature's Call
selection.description: Spawn number of Treants under the command of the caster.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Spawns a Treant when an enemy summon or illusion dies, and a Greater Treant when an enemy hero dies.

selection.name: Nether Swap
selection.description: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Allied swapped units receive less damage for a short duration.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Cooldown reduced by -20 seconds, damage reduction buff increased by +15%.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: After Nether swap is cast, fears enemies in a 700 area of effect for 1.5 seconds.

selection.name: Nethertoxin
selection.description: Viper releases a Nethertoxin at the targeted area. Units in that area take an increasing damage over time based on how long they remain in it. Disables passives of affected units.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Enemy units affected by Nethertoxin is silenced.

selection.name: Omnislash
selection.description:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: The hero has a 20% to perform a 0.8s Omnislash on attack against their target. This cannot proc while Omnislashing.
